interface.longDescription: QUMI FLY BRIDGE by Mohammed Mansour for Qumi Teknolojis (trading name of QROO Inc.). Provides a direct connection to Fly.io's official OAuth-protected remote MCP server at https://mcp.fly.io, plus an independent agent-local MCP runtime exposing flyctl installation, live command discovery, health checks, authenticated read operations and individually approved state-changing CLI commands. No organization, app, account, path or credentials are bundled. Each operator authorizes Fly MCP through the official browser OAuth flow; CLI authentication uses Fly's own login, a platform-injected FLY_API_TOKEN, or a local passphrase-encrypted vault unlocked only at execution. Includes official fly skills/setup agent guidance and controlled local installation for Codex, Claude Code and other MCP clients. Separate official MCP and CLI surfaces avoid hardcoding upstream tools. Fly MCP capabilities are governed by the actual connected server and OAuth grants.
interface.shortDescription: Fly MCP and CLI for agents
